## About

I build backend and full-stack software. My public repositories so far: a CNN that classifies brain MRI scans behind a Flask page, an Express API that scores CSV leads with keyword rules plus an LLM, and a SQLite desktop app for employee records.

B.Tech CSE graduate, 2025.
